privacy.title: PRIVACY POLICY
privacy.subheading: Your privacy matters to us. Learn how we handle your data with care.
privacy.description: At Resomix, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our service.
privacy.information_we_collect_1: We collect the following types of information:
privacy.information_we_collect_2: Audio files that you upload to our service
privacy.information_we_collect_3: Feedback and survey responses you provide
privacy.information_we_collect_4: Usage data and analytics about how you interact with our service
privacy.information_we_collect_5: We Technical information such as your IP address, browser type, and device information
privacy.how_we_use_2: Provide and improve our music recommendation services
privacy.how_we_use_3: Analyze musical patterns and features in uploaded tracks
privacy.how_we_use_5: Communicate with you about our services
privacy.how_we_use_6: Monitor and analyze usage patterns and trends
privacy.data_retention_1: We retain your uploaded audio files and associated data for as long as necessary to provide our services. You can request deletion of your data at any time by contacting us.
privacy.data_security_1: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, and destruction.
privacy.your_rights_1: Depending on your location, you may have rights regarding your personal information, including:
privacy.your_rights_5: Object to or restrict processing of your information
privacy.changes_to_policy_1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.
privacy.contact_us_1: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at

about_hero.for_djs_who_feel: for DJs who feel the music

about_one.mission_paragraph:
Putting together a set that tells a story is no trivial task.
Tracks that perfectly fit (tonally and emotionally) with our mix are often
hard to find, especially now that most platforms focus more on tags
and popularity metrics rather than intention and vibe.
about_one.headline_alternative_route:
Resomix shows an alternative route
to superficial music matches
about_one.tech_paragraph:
We use advanced audio analysis and deep learning technology
to truly understand a song: from tempo shifts to harmonic
tension, dynamic range, and more.
about_one.result_paragraph:
The result is a music recommendation based on emotion
and structure, and not just labels or metadata.

about_two.preamble_one:
What we care about is that you find the right track for the right moment,
the one that can galvanize your audience and make you stand out as a DJ.
about_two.preamble_two:
We're here to make that process faster, more intuitive,
and based on what matters the most: the music.
about_two.vision_intro: We believe you deserve better tools to craft your set and explore the depth of your musical taste.
about_two.vision_span:
Resomix finds hidden connections because we know that music doesn't need a high chart position to be relevant. The platform
analyzes every aspect of a song's structure, to map its sonic DNA and find a perfect match, regardless of who released it or when.
about_two.diff_intro: Our music discovery system is based on a deep learning algorithm that identifies musical patterns on a granular level.
about_two.diff_span:
Playing outside of the "streaming game," Resomix can find unknown tunes and hidden gems that reflect the essence
of your reference.
about_two.card_analysis_desc: No artificial curation, no shortcutting the research; just an innovative way of doing audio analysis through deep learning algorithms.
about_two.card_craft_desc:
Resomix explores what defines
a track: its subtlety, dynamics, flow, rhythm,
texture, energy, and more.
Just like when DJs read the room while
performing, our deep-learning engine delivers
personalized results based
on hard data, not trends.
about_two.card_path_title:
A Faster Path
to the Right Track
about_two.card_path_desc:
Within seconds, you'll have a carefully crafted
selection of tracks that resonate with your
reference's vibe, regardless of genre, release
date, or popularity.

about_three.intro: Resomix searches across catalogs and archives using carefully developed similarity patterns.
about_three.intro_span:
Popularity metrics are not taken into account in the research, which is why our platform makes it easier to
uncover hidden gems, unknown albums, and artists flying under the radar.
about_three.card_discovery_desc:
Resomix starts off by reading the spectral flow of the audio provided. It compares
rhythm, tone, and spectral fingerprints of music online until it finds the right fits.
about_three.card_simplicity_desc: Resomix's interface is fast, focused, and intuitive: simply drag, drop, and dig.
about_three.card_inclusion_desc:
Here, underrepresented artists and genres can find their audience and thrive,
with a discovery engine that prioritizes sonic similarities above all else.
about_three.card_speed_desc: By sampling micro-transients in real time, Resomix delivers fast, latency-tested results.
about_three.card_open_desc:
Transparent data, open APIs, and clear licensing. Resomix makes it easy for partners,
labels, platforms,and developers to collaborate and create a more open music ecosystem.
about_three.card_quality_desc:
Resomix filters results with care, and lets you control how many recommendations you
see every time.
about_three.card_crate_desc:
You still make the call; we only help you get there quicker. Resomix is a platform that'll
broaden your sonic horizon by exposing you to songs that might never appear through
standard search or streaming algorithms.

about_four.audience_djs_desc: — who need the perfect tracks to make their sets unforgettable.
about_four.audience_producers_desc: — looking for new inspiration to reflect a song's vibe.
about_four.audience_curators_desc: — who create cohesive playlists with their unique taste.
about_four.audience_music_enthusiasts_desc: — exploring the boundaries of music, beyond charts or trends.
about_four.run_by:
Resomix is run by DJs, engineers,
and music professionals
about_four.mission:
We want to build a better way
to discover and enjoy music across genres
